35.43% — 62 of 175 miRNAs show significant differential expression between patient and control groups before multiple testing correction (per-miRNA Welch two-sample t-test on Ct values, two-sided, unadjusted p < 0.05, missing "NAN" cells handled by pairwise deletion).

Sensitivity checks:
- Student's t-test (denom 175): 66/175 = 37.71%
- Wilcoxon rank-sum (denom 175): 58/175 = 33.14%
- Excluding the 14 miRNAs with any missing value (denom 161): Welch 59/161 = 36.65%, Student 63/161 = 39.13%, Wilcoxon 56/161 = 34.78%
- Overall sensitivity range: 33.1%–39.1%; the answer is robustly in the mid-30s regardless of test or missing-data handling.
